== Description ==
'''SHA-2''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier.

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-2''' has a chance of spawning behind the main room's door upon entering during the Shadow Challenge event. '''SHA-2''' will make the screen slightly shake and a nearly silent noise once he starts to move. Once '''SHA-2''' backtracks, it will go all the way back to the void wall where he will despawn. If the player is seen while entering/exiting a hiding spot, they will be inflicted with the shadow plague effect, causing them to lose some of their health overtime.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Pay attention to sound cues and screen-shake that might announce it's arrival. If you're in '''A&SP''', is easier to detect his sound.
** In '''A&SP''', '''SHA-2''' can spawn together with '''infected''' shadow entities, so make sure to hide if an '''infected''' shadow spawn.
** If you can't hear '''SHA-2''', then look for the screen-shake upon opening a door (but don't misinterpret it with other shadows screen-shakes like [[SHA-1]] does.
* '''SHA-2''', along with [[SHA-1]]'s instakill can be avoided by dodge-rolling, use this in dire situations when no hiding spots are available! You will still be damaged as if you were being lockersniped though.

== Trivia ==
* '''SHA-2''' can invade by itself During any Perfection Event
* '''SHA-2''' can be spawned by [[SHA-180]],  [[SHA-60]] and [[SHA-3]].
* '''SHA-2''' replaces [[D-5]] in the tutorial room if you are in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse|A&SP]]
* '''SHA-2''' will get faster the more you progress in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse|A&SP]], you can notice that by his ambience's pitch.
